name: Localized Point Management (LPM)
definition: A point management technique that improves Gaussian Splatting by identifying error source zones in 3D space via cross-view mapping and performing localized point addition, reset, and pruning to correct under-optimized or ill-conditioned points.
summary: Localized Point Management is a 3D Gaussian Splatting optimization that targets specific error zones via cross-view mapping to correct points, unlike global gradient-based methods.
